display_name: Discrete Linear System & Difference Equation Skill
source_pattern_name_zh: 差分方程/离散状态空间系统/死拍观测器设计
activation_signals: Problem presents a difference equation Σ aₖ y[n-k] = f[n] and asks for closed-form solution with initial conditions.
Problem presents a discrete-time state-space system x[n+1]=Ax[n]+Bu[n], y[n]=Cx[n] and asks for observer or controller design.
Problem asks to design a deadbeat observer (observation error reaches zero in minimum finite steps).
Problem asks to reduce a system to observer or controller canonical form.
Key vocabulary: 'difference equation', 'closed-form solution', 'observer canonical form', 'deadbeat', 'observation error identically zero', 'gain matrix', 'discrete-time system', 'z-transform'.
problem_signatures: 题目给出差分方程如 8y[n] - 6y[n-1] + y[n-2] = 1，初始条件 y[0]=1, y[-1]=2，求闭合解。
题目给出离散状态空间 A, B, C 矩阵，要求设计使观测误差在最短步数内为零的观测器。
题目要求将状态空间系统化为观测器/控制器标准形式。
题目涉及离散传递函数和 z-变换的分析。
likely_failure_modes: For difference equations, forgetting to find the particular solution when RHS is non-zero.
For deadbeat observer: choosing poles near zero rather than exactly at zero.
Applying continuous-time transformation formulas instead of discrete-time ones for canonical forms.
For repeated characteristic roots: missing n·rⁿ terms in the general solution.
Off-by-one with initial conditions: y[0] and y[-1] mapping incorrectly.

sop_phases.title: Phase 1 — Classify & Set Up
steps: Difference equation: write in standard form, identify order m and coefficients {aₖ}.
Find characteristic roots: python scripts/discrete_system_solver.py charpoly --A '...' OR use sympy.solve on characteristic polynomial.
State-space: check controllability and observability ranks: python scripts/discrete_system_solver.py stability --A '...'
Identify the answer type: closed-form coefficients / gain matrix / canonical form matrices.

sop_phases.title: Phase 2 — Solve Homogeneous + Particular
steps: Homogeneous: for each distinct root rᵢ with multiplicity mᵢ, contribution = (c_{i,0} + c_{i,1}·n + …)·rᵢⁿ.
Particular solution: constant RHS → try y_p = K; if 1 is a root → try y_p = A·n. Exponential RHS → try y_p = A·αⁿ.
Apply initial conditions to solve for all constants using sympy.

sop_phases.title: Phase 3 — State-Space Design
steps: Deadbeat observer: all eigenvalues of (A-LC) placed exactly at 0. Run: python scripts/discrete_system_solver.py deadbeat --A '...' --C '...'
Canonical form reduction: python scripts/discrete_system_solver.py canonical --A '...' --B '...' --C '...' --form observer
Minimum deadbeat steps = observability index (smallest k with rank(O_k) = n).

sop_phases.title: Phase 4 — Verification & Format
steps: Difference equation: substitute closed-form back into equation, check for n=0,1,2.
Observer: verify eigenvalues of (A-LC) are exactly at desired locations.
Canonical form: verify A_tilde = T A T⁻¹ numerically.

subtype_playbook: **2nd-order diff eq with distinct real roots** (8y[n]-6y[n-1]+y[n-2]=1): roots=(1/2),(1/4), particular y_p=1/3, general=c₁(1/2)ⁿ+c₂(1/4)ⁿ+1/3.
**Deadbeat observer for nth-order system**: minimum steps = observability index ν. Use scipy.signal.place_poles with all poles at 0.
**z-transform approach**: Y(z) = H(z)·U(z) + I(z). Partial-fraction expand, inverse-transform.
**Observer canonical form**: build companion matrix from characteristic polynomial coefficients.
output_rules: Closed-form: use the exact template from the problem (e.g., y[n] = A(B)ⁿ + C(D)ⁿ + E).
Gain matrix: list as a matrix matching the problem's notation.
Integer answers (e.g., minimum steps): bare numeral.
Multi-part: follow problem's ordering and separator exactly.
